up: Return the first 1000 activity rows for the human single-protein target with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1255163 (Protein-serine O-palmitoleoyltransferase porcupine). Filter for activities with standard_type = 'IC50', exact standard_relation = '=', and non-null pchembl_value. Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. For each row, return the following columns: assay ChEMBL ID (from assays), target type (from target_dictionary), tax_id (from target_dictionary), canonical SMILES (from compound_structures), molecule ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary), standard type (from activities), and pChEMBL value (from activities).
sql: SELECT DISTINCT ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, td.target_type, td.tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, a.standard_type, a.pchembl_value FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1255163' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id, ass.chembl_id LIMIT 1000
